source_text.body:
Run full-stack SEO with an n8n agent
An n8n agent analyzes GA4, rank and SERP data, tracks competitor keywords, rewrites articles and saves performance reports.
·
Feb 19, 2026
Done with
N8
n8n
What they did
The n8n agent was set up to analyze GA4, rank, and SERP data; crawl and clean FAQ content; track competitor keywords; auto-rewrite articles; and save reports plus performance metrics. No further steps, tool access details, or human intervention points are described.
How it went
The post states no results, metrics, or shortcomings.
Worth knowing
Full workflow offered free via DM after following and replying; one reply warns of manual penalties from blind automation.
Try it yourself
with
n8n
Copy prompt
Build an n8n workflow that runs weekly: pull traffic data from [GA4 property], rankings for [my keyword list], and the competitor keywords for [competitor domains]. Have an AI step suggest rewrites for the three articles losing the most traffic and save a performance report to [Google Sheet or Notion page]. Send me the drafted rewrites for approval instead of publishing them automatically.
Original source: https://x.com/SimslearnAi/status/2024630804081729617
